why: PI-20260927-YZRZQ725-0001 / review-pack D1. The shadow-drift gate (/api/bot/shadow/drift, src/web/api/routers/shadow.py) computed its reference window by reading ONLY the currently-active shadow_predictions.jsonl. scripts/ops/rotate_shadow_log.py (run daily via ict-shadow-log-rotate.timer, --gzip in deploy/ict-shadow-log-rotate.service) renames that active log to a dated archive roughly every 25-29 days in production (rotation observed 2026-09-26T06:39:57Z) and starts a fresh empty file -- a cadence SHORTER than the endpoint's own 30-day reference_days default. So a read anchored at 'now' truncates its own reference window at the last rotation boundary, and every advisory model (mes-regime-5m-lgbm-v2, sol-regime-15m-lgbm-fc-pcv-v2, the btc regime family, etc.) reads insufficient_data for roughly 1-2 weeks after each rotation -- no drift-based demote/hold decision this repo has made, including the one referred to as 'E72', was ever computed on a genuinely full window. THE FIX: ml/shadow/inspector.py gains rotated_log_paths(active_log), which discovers archives beside the active log by the exact naming rotate_shadow_log.py::_next_rotated_path produces (<stem>.<suffix>.jsonl, optionally .gz), and iter_records() now transparently reads a .gz file via gzip.open (production runs --gzip, so every archive it will ever be asked to read is gzipped) -- both pure reads, no write path touched. src/web/api/routers/shadow.py's drift() now unions iter_records over the active log plus every discovered archive before applying the SAME reference/current window filters as before (no behavior change to the window math itself, only to what gets read into it), and discloses what it read via a new rotated_logs_read envelope field (count + paths) so a caller can see the fix engaged rather than inferring it. VERIFICATION: added TestDriftEndpointRotation (4 tests) to tests/test_web_api_shadow.py, the existing home for this router's tests. test_rotation_boundary_inside_window_fills_reference_window constructs the exact failure shape -- a gzipped archive covering ~30d-8d ago (5 records) plus an active log covering the last ~5 days (3 records), with the rotation boundary sitting inside the default [now-37d, now) window -- and asserts verdict != insufficient_data, reference_count == 5, current_count == 3, and real reference_mean/current_mean/ks/psi values. test_multiple_rotations_all_read proves the union is not just the newest archive (two rotations, one gzipped one plain, both folded in). test_genuinely_insufficient_data_still_reported_as_such is the required POSITIVE CONTROL: an archive is present and IS read (rotated_logs_read.count == 1), but every one of its records sits before reference_window_start, so reference_count is genuinely 0 and verdict stays insufficient_data -- proving the fix does not just always report sufficient. test_no_rotation_present_behaves_as_before pins rotated_logs_read.count == 0 and unchanged behavior when nothing has rotated. VERIFIED FAILING WITHOUT THE FIX: git stash'd ml/shadow/inspector.py + src/web/api/routers/shadow.py (keeping only the new tests), reran tests/test_web_api_shadow.py -> 4 of 4 new tests failed (3 x KeyError: 'rotated_logs_read', 1 x AssertionError on verdict == insufficient_data), 15 pre-existing tests still passed; git stash pop restored the fix, full suite is 19 passed, 0 failed. Also ran tests/ml/test_shadow_backfill.py + test_shadow_drift.py + test_shadow_drift_cli.py + test_web_api_diag.py (75 passed) and tests/ml/test_shadow_inspector.py (37 passed, including its own iter_records/coverage tests) for regressions -- none. ruff check on all three touched files: All checks passed. grep confirms every OTHER iter_records(...) call site in the repo (ml/cli.py, ml/shadow/drift_retrain.py, ml/promotion/live_parity.py, ml/promotion/attribution.py, ml/promotion/stage_guard.py, src/web/api/routers/trade_scores.py) passes a Path/str, so the added .gz branch is purely additive and cannot change their behavior (none of those paths end in .gz today). Scope is deliberately narrow: only the /drift endpoint's read is changed; /predictions and /stats are untouched (their own rotation-censoring problem is already handled by the existing soak_start_basis/registry mechanism, a separate fix, out of scope here). No config/**, no src/runtime/orders.py or any TIER3_PATHS file, no deploy/**, no account-mode or execution-gate value anywhere in the diff.
